_readme: Every price carries a source and the date it was read. 'assumed' entries are StealthCo assumptions, not vendor prices. Re-run cost_calculator.py after editing.

prompt_caching.note: cache read = 0.1x input, 5-min write = 1.25x input.  The prototype's system prefix (~350 tokens) is below all three minimums.

claude-sonnet-5.note: $2/$10 introductory price made permanent per the pricing page note

claude-haiku-4-5.note: retirement not sooner than 2026-10-15 per models overview; plan for a successor

deepseek-flash-api.note: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash hosted API, peak rates. REFERENCE ONLY: no BAA, data terms and jurisdiction unsuitable for PHI; not a candidate.

gpu_hosting._unknown: Whether RunPod or Lambda will sign a HIPAA BAA for these SKUs was not checked. Hyperscaler GPU rates were not read; none is asserted.

open_weight_candidate.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
open_weight_candidate.weight_memory_note: DERIVED, not measured: 284B params at a blended ~0.6 bytes/param (FP4 experts, FP8 rest). Vendor does not state GPU requirements. KV cache and runtime overhead extra.
open_weight_candidate.throughput_note: No throughput benchmark is asserted. At the volumes below, utilization is bounded by patient traffic, not GPU capacity. 24/7 service is a modeling CHOICE (patients text at any hour; a queue-and-batch design was not modeled), not a requirement inferred from the model.
open_weight_candidate.why_not_v4_pro: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is 1.6T params; multi-node serving, out of scope for a pre-seed team.

sms.carrier_fee_note: Twilio lists AT&T $0.0035 and T-Mobile $0.0045 per long-code outbound SMS; $0.0040 is a blended assumption. Verizon and inbound carrier fees not read.
sms.a2p_10dlc_note: UNKNOWN: Twilio's pricing page says A2P 10DLC has onboarding fees but does not list them. Brand + campaign registration and monthly campaign fees must be confirmed before launch.
sms.failed_message_note: Twilio's page lists a failed-message fee and inbound carrier fees; not read into this model (unknown).

hosting_app.note: ASSUMED. One small VM + managed Postgres + backups + monitoring for the workflow service. No vendor quote fetched. A BAA-capable host (AWS/GCP/Azure with signed BAA) is required for PHI; expect the low end of $100-300/mo at this scale.

human.note: ASSUMED contractor rate for nonclinical operations support if Kate's time is replaced. Founder time is reported in hours and NOT priced into per-patient cost; founder compensation is listed separately.

founder_comp.note: Recorded provision; not an operating cost of the software.

partner_feed_adapter_and_matching.note: SFTP/FHIR export ingestion, identifier mapping, reconciliation; depends entirely on the partner's interface

messaging_go_live.note: 10DLC registration, Twilio webhook hardening, delivery receipts, opt-out audit

live_model_evaluation.note: replace mock with live adapter, build labeled eval set from partner-approved samples, measure intent accuracy and escalation precision

security_review_allowance.note: pro forma Turn 11 allowance (Sara Lazarus line); not a quote

legal_baa_privacy.note: ASSUMED allowance: BAA, partner contact-process approval, consent language review
